questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&“\text{最多一人需用台秤}”\text{就是说}“\text{正好一人需用台秤}”\text{或者}“\text{都不需要台秤}”，“\text{正好一人需用台秤}”\text{的概率是} \\&C_{4}^{1}\frac{1}{4}(1-\frac{1}{4})^{1}=\frac{108}{256},\quad“\text{都不需要台秤}”\text{的概率为} (1-\frac{1}{4})^{4}=\frac{81}{256}，\text{所以}“\text{正好一人需用台秤}”\text{的概率为} \\&\frac{108}{256}+\frac{81}{256}=\frac{189}{256}\approx 0.738\,.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{设 } A,\; B,\; C \text{ 分别表示在这段时间内机床甲、乙、丙需要工人照管，因无人照管而停工即有两台或两台以上机床需要照管，此事件可表示为 } AB \cup AC \cup BC.\text{ 于是，所求概率为} \\ P(AB \cup AC \cup BC) = P(AB) + P(AC) + P(BC) - 2P(ABC) \\ = P(A)P(B) + P(A)P(C) + P(B)P(C) - 2P(A)P(B)P(C) \\ = 0.1 \times 0.2 + 0.1 \times 0.15 + 0.2 \times 0.15 - 2(0.1 \times 0.2 \times 0.15) = 0.059.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} P(E) &= P(AB \cup C \cup D) \\ &= P(AB) + P(C) + P(D) - P(ABC) - P(ABD) - P(CD) + P(ABCD) \\ &= P(A)P(B) + P(C) + P(D) - P(A)P(B)P(C) - P(A)P(B)P(D) - P(C)P(D) + P(A)P(B)P(C)P(D) \\ &= 0.8125, \\ P(AB|E) &= \frac{P(AB)}{P(E)} = \frac{0.25}{0.8125} \approx 0.31. \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}& \text{设} \, A=\{ \text{甲射击一次击中目标}\}, \, B=\{ \text{乙射击一次击中目标}\}, \text{则由题意可知} \, A,B \text{是相互独立的，两人同时射击各一次目标被击中就是.}\\& P(A \cup B)=P(A)+P(B)-P(AB)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)=0.6+0.5-0.6 \times 0.5=0.8.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}& \text{事件}A: \text{“从第一个口袋中摸出白球”}, \text{事件}B: \text{“从第二个口袋中摸出白球”}, \text{所以要求的事件可以表示为} \\& \overline{AB}+\overline{AB}, \text{又由于}\overline{AB}, \overline{AB} \text{互不相容，且}A,B \text{相互独立，所以} \\& P(\overline{A}\overline{B}+\overline{AB})=P(A)\overline{P(B)}+P(\overline{A})P(B)=\frac{4}{4+2}\times \frac{5}{3+5}+\frac{2}{4+2}\times \frac{3}{3+5}=\frac{13}{24}.\end{aligned}
